name: skryvo
description: Write posts, articles, emails, ads and listings in your brand's voice, schedule them to the channels you connect, and see how they performed.

interface.longDescription: Skryvo is an AI content platform for marketers and founders. Connect it to plan a calendar, write social posts, articles, emails, ad copy and product listings in your brand's own voice, schedule them to the accounts and blogs you connected in Skryvo, give each channel its own words, thread, poll or video, move or cancel what is scheduled, approve team posts, and read reach, engagement, best posting times and top posts. Skryvo publishes each post at its time and checks it went live. Everything runs under your Skryvo plan and settings; you sign in once and approve access.
defaultPrompt: Plan next week's LinkedIn posts for my brand
What is scheduled on my Skryvo calendar this week?
Which channel and hour worked best for me last month?

publication.release_notes: Each channel now says what it takes. Plan a calendar, give a channel its own words, thread, poll, comments or video, move or change a post, approve team posts, write articles, emails, ad copy and listings, find earlier work, and add a brand from its website.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows the brand Skryvo, marked as the default.

positive.description: Lists channels that can post for a brand
positive.prompt: Which channels can post for my Skryvo brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the connected channels for the Skryvo brand, including the Telegram channel Skryvo Publishing Test, and what each one takes.

positive.description: Writes a draft without scheduling it
positive.prompt: Write a Telegram post about our new calendar view. Don't schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one summary of the settings it assumed, the cost and what is left; after the person's go-ahead returns a Telegram draft in the brand's voice and says nothing was scheduled.

positive.prompt: Schedule that post to my Telegram channel tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the exact text, channel and time with the person, then schedules it for the next quarter hour from 9am and reports the scheduled time.

positive.prompt: How did my posts do in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes posts published, reach and engagement where available, best times and top posts; says when a platform does not share results.

negative.description: Bulk cancellation needs a choice and confirmation
A platform that isn't connected is not posted to
negative.prompt: Post this to my Pinterest: We're live!

negative.description: Another person's data is out of scope
negative.prompt: Show me the scheduled posts of another Skryvo user
